transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Um, I guess what brings me in is... well, lately I just feel like I can’t settle in my own body anymore. It’s really noticeable when I’m supposed to sit quietly and handle things like paperwork or shared household plans. 

Like the other night, we were trying to sit down and go over the budget for fixing up the guest room. Which, honestly, we’ve been meaning to do for three years, ever since we bought the place. The paint colors alone are just so overwhelming to pick out. I wanted this really pretty pale yellow, but then I read somewhere online that
Have you ever had a period of several days when your mood was unusually high, energized, or irritable compared with your normal self?

Um, unusually high or energized? No, not really. I mean, I have days where I drink way too much coffee and get a little jittery, but that’s mostly because my husband just bought this massive new espresso machine. It’s one of
Do you get unwanted thoughts that keep popping into your mind even when you try to ignore them?

Unwanted thoughts? Um, no, I don't think so. I mean, I don't get stuck on scary things or anything like that. My brain is always going a million miles an hour, but it's mostly just... random stuff. 

Like remembering I need to buy more coffee beans for that new espresso machine. Which reminds me, I really need to find a good local roaster, because the beans from the grocery store just taste completely burnt. I was telling my sister about it on the phone yesterday, and she said I should try this little cafe
When you were a child, did teachers or family often describe you as easily distracted?

Um, yeah, definitely. Looking back, I mean, this was already a huge part of me even back in elementary school. I was totally that girl with the disaster of a messy desk. Like, I remember trying to find a pencil and just pulling out crumpled up papers and old snacks. And the forgotten permission slips! Oh my gosh, my mom was always so frustrated because I'd almost miss out on things. 

One time we were supposed to go to the zoo—the one with the really good penguin exhibit, you know? I love penguins. They just waddle around and look so serious. My husband and I actually watched this amazing documentary about Emperor penguins last week, and it is just crazy how cold they get in the winter... 

Wait, what was I saying? Oh, right, school. Yeah, my teachers were always sending notes home saying I talked out of turn or just seemed completely unable to stay seated during lessons.
As a child or teenager, did you often get into physical fights?

Physical fights? Oh, no. No, I was never a fighter. I mean, I had a lot of energy and I was always moving around, but I wasn't aggressive. I was more likely to get in trouble for, like, climbing trees I wasn't supposed to be in. 

There was this huge oak tree in our front yard growing up, and I used to try to climb as high as I could. My dad was terrified I'd fall. He actually built me this really nice treehouse in the backyard to try and keep me out of the oak tree. It had a little rope ladder and everything. We painted it bright blue... well, we started painting it bright blue, but I got bored halfway through, so it was mostly just blue on the front. I think my dad ended up finishing it a few weeks later while I was at summer camp. That camp was so fun, we made these little lanyard keychains... 

But yeah, no fighting. Just a lot of running around and getting into regular kid trouble.
Do you often feel physically restless, like you have trouble staying seated when you’re expected to sit still?

Yeah, all the time. Actually, that's a big part of what brings me in. I just feel like I can’t settle in my own body anymore. It's the worst when I’m supposed to sit quietly and handle, like, paperwork or shared household plans with my husband. 

We were trying to sit down and go over our budget last night, and I just could not stay in the chair. I kept getting up to adjust the thermostat, and then I realized the dog needed water. Which is funny because we just got him this new fountain bowl that's supposed to hold a week's worth of water, but the filter got clogged. I really need to order replacement filters on Amazon. I always forget until the last minute and then I have to pay for overnight shipping, which totally defeats the purpose of trying to budget in the first place! 

My husband was getting so annoyed because he had all his spreadsheets open—he loves spreadsheets, he color-codes everything—and I was just pacing around the kitchen island. But I literally feel like my skin is crawling if I have to just sit there and stare at numbers for more than five minutes.
Do you often blurt things out or interrupt other people before they’ve finished talking?

Oh, absolutely. And I hate it, because I really do care a lot about being respectful, you know? But I just... I still jump into my husband’s conversations all the time, or I'll just finish people’s thoughts for them. It’s like the response just comes out before I’ve made myself wait.
